exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Poisoned Pipeline Execution
exploitedBy.relevance: Untrusted code execution in pipeline definitions is the core concept of poisoned pipeline execution attacks.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools
exploitedBy.relevance: Attackers can inject untrusted execution through compromised development tools or dependencies in pipeline definitions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Escape to Host
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessive host privileges on runners enables container escape to the underlying host system.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Container Service
exploitedBy.relevance: Misconfigured container services with excessive privileges can be abused for privilege escalation on the host.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Unsecured Credentials
exploitedBy.relevance: Secrets exposed in pipeline logs represent unsecured credentials accessible to anyone with log access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Log Enumeration
exploitedBy.relevance: Attackers can enumerate pipeline logs specifically to discover exposed secrets and credentials.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Installer Packages
exploitedBy.relevance: Malicious packages introduced via dependency confusion can execute code through installer package mechanisms.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Cloud Secrets Management Stores
exploitedBy.relevance: Overprivileged pipeline secrets often include cloud secrets management store credentials with excessive permissions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Credentials In Files
exploitedBy.relevance: Pipeline secret scoping issues can lead to credentials being accessible in pipeline definition files.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak pipeline API authentication enables attackers to steal application access tokens for unauthorized access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak authentication allows abuse of application access tokens to authenticate to pipeline APIs.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Access Token Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Unrestricted registration tokens can be manipulated to gain elevated access within the CI/CD pipeline environment.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Implant Internal Image
exploitedBy.relevance: Poisoned build caches can implant malicious content into internal images used by subsequent pipeline runs.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Software Deployment Tools
exploitedBy.relevance: Without network segmentation, compromised runners can leverage deployment tools to move laterally across environments.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Serverless Execution
exploitedBy.relevance: Absent network segmentation allows pipeline runners unrestricted access to internal services and cloud execution environments.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient pipeline audit logging mirrors the impact of disabling cloud logs, leaving pipeline activities undetectable.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Automated Exfiltration
exploitedBy.relevance: Unmonitored inter-stage data transfer enables automated exfiltration of sensitive data between pipeline stages.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration to Code Repository
exploitedBy.relevance: Pipeline stage data can be exfiltrated to external code repositories without monitoring controls in place.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
exploitedBy.relevance: Unmonitored inter-stage communication channels can be exploited for exfiltration over alternative protocols.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Malicious Image
exploitedBy.relevance: Unpinned base images can be replaced with malicious images that execute attacker-controlled code in the build environment.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Run Virtual Instance
exploitedBy.relevance: Lack of runner job isolation can be exploited by running virtual instances to escape job boundaries.
